title: Card Use over the Last 12 Months and the Late-Fee Courtesy Share — Crestline Credit Card
content:
Northgate's late-fee courtesy credit on the Crestline Credit Card recognizes use of the card: when the purchases posted to the account fewer than 12 months before today total at least 1,500 USD and at least one of them carries a promotional plan, 0.10 is added to the share of the late fee that the courtesy credit returns; when they total at least 750 USD without meeting that test, 0.05 is added; otherwise nothing is added. The share, with every addition made to it, never exceeds 1.0 — the whole fee.

## Addition table

| Purchases posted fewer than 12 months before today total | At least one on a promotional plan | Added to the share |
|---|---|---|
| 1,500 USD or more | yes | 0.10 (10 percentage points) |
| 1,500 USD or more | no | 0.05 |
| at least 750 USD but under 1,500 USD | any | 0.05 |
| under 750 USD | any | nothing |

Thresholds as figures: 1500.0 USD and 750.0 USD; a total exactly on a threshold meets it.

## Records read

The purchase entries on the card ledger posted fewer than 12 months before today — their amounts, and whether each carries a promotional plan (a deferred-interest or equal-payment plan) or none.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- 1,500.00 USD of purchases, one on a 6-month deferred plan: 0.10. Total 1,499.99 USD with the same plan: 0.05.
- 2,300.00 USD of purchases, all standard: 0.05.
- 749.99 USD of purchases: nothing.
